title: Dudu's Performance Pack
description: A lightweight client-side modpack focused on performance optimization and subtle visual improvements. Built for smooth gameplay with shaders, voice chat, and multiplayer-friendly enhancements.
body:
# Dudu's Performance Pack
This is a lightweight, client-side modpack built for smoother, better-looking Minecraft without changing core gameplay. Originally made for a private server with friends, it’s now available for anyone wanting better performance and clean visual upgrades.

## What You Get
- FPS Boosts with mods like Sodium, FerriteCore, Lithium, and ModernFix
- Visual Polish with Fresh Animations, Complementary Shaders, and Entity Texture Features
- Quality-of-Life Tweaks like AppleSkin, Mouse Tweaks, and Zoomify
- Multiplayer-Friendly: includes Simple Voice Chat, No Chat Reports, and VMP for large servers
